description.value: Oma's Bakery & Market is a combined bakery and market serving the Duncan area of Vancouver Island. The 'Oma's' name (Dutch/German for grandmother) suggests a homestyle or artisan baking tradition. As a market-bakery hybrid it could offer touring cyclists a convenient stop for baked goods and general provisions.
